item.title: [−1] Fed's Hammack, Barkin favor gradual rate-hike path to lower inflation
item.description:
Signal: tighter US monetary policy (US). 6 reports from Reuters, FXStreet, www.tmgm.com and 3 more. Related: “Cleveland Fed President: "Further Tightening Needed to Curb Inflation"”. New in the last 24 hours.

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Funding costs rise

Why it matters: Higher US rates and yields pull foreign money out of emerging markets, weaken the rupee and push up Indian bond yields.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Rupee −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Treasury, European Bond Yields Tumble as Markets Lifted by U.S. Democrats’ Victory
item.description:
Signal: falling US Treasury yields (US). 7 reports from CNBC, WSJ, Moomoo and 4 more. Related: “10-year Treasury yield falls as traders exit tech stocks, look ahead to jobs data”. New in the last 24 hours.

Real estate: mild tailwind (+1) — Funding costs ease

Why it matters: Lower US rates and yields send foreign money back to emerging markets, supporting the rupee, Indian bonds and equities.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows +3, Rupee +1, Bond market (G-Secs) +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−2] RBI tightens cyber oversight of non-bank payment system operators
item.description:

Real estate: headwind (−2) — Home loans get dearer

Why it matters: A higher repo rate lifts loan rates for homes, vehicles and businesses and pushes up bond yields, though it supports the rupee and lenders' margins at first.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] India’s retail inflation rises to 4.45% in July, food inflation at 5.52%
item.description:
